sources.title: DavidAU/Qwen3.5-4B-Deckard-HERETIC-UNCENSORED-Thinking
sources.snippet: It significantly improves reasoning and output generation, outperforming the base Qwen3.5-4B-Instruct model on various benchmarks. This model is designed to be uncensored and 'heretic,' providing direct responses without refusal, and supports vision capabilities.

sources.title: Architecture graph for DavidAU/Qwen3.5-4B-Deckard-HERETIC-UNCENSORED ...
sources.snippet: DavidAU/Qwen3.5-4B-Deckard-HERETIC-UNCENSORED-Thinking is an image-text-to-text model (qwen3_5_text architecture). It uses 32 transformer layers, a hidden size of 2,560, and 16 query heads with 4 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 9,216.
